neighbours.label: 'how'/'ways' introducing the means by which someone can help, contribute or improve (see how you can give back, looking for ways to), as against 'how' asking about facts or describing a mechanism
fire: Talk to the shelter staff and learn how you can volunteer this winter.

Join the meeting on Thursday to hear how you can support local farmers.

Read our guide to discover ways you can cut your energy bill.
The charity wants to know how we can reach more families in need.
Visit our website and see how your donation can change a child's life.

Our nurses are always busy on the night shift in winter.
The diagram shows how blood flows through the four chambers of the heart.
The manager asked how long the meeting would take.
Read our guide to the history of the old mill.
The scientist described how glaciers carve valleys over time.
Visit our website and see the photos from last year's fair.
